records.localization_note: Hodram Bergstrom is the approved nameplate for the admiral. The opinions he hears from the crew stay in their own voices.
Janus Pasar is both the approved speaker name and the signature in his letter. The name now has a separate final row in the letter body.
Jam Ludwyan is the short nameplate. Jam Jack Ludwyan remains the name he signs in his letter from India.
Cesare Tony keeps his approved caption. His disciplined speech distinguishes him from the sailors he criticizes.
Gerhard Adernkatz keeps the established surname and distinct voice in the sunset, Attila, and Martel exchanges.
Al Shin speaks for himself when discussing Saladin. The shared merchant speaks separately.
Charles Rochefort remains the short nameplate. Charles Jean Rochefort is the established signature in his letter.
Carlo Sinat gives the lead about the old medical book and addresses Filippo by name in the neighboring trade scene.
Fernando Dias is the crewmate scoffing at Jam's boasting. His regular English capital F remains the same in the caption and the letter.
Ian Dukov is the approved nameplate and signature. The sender name Ian in the crew announcements refers to him.
Samwell Khan is the approved short nameplate for the three matching rumors. The catalogue keeps its longer representation.
Manuel Almeida keeps his established name and his reflective, familiar delivery about Attila and the chisel.
Yifa Sol is the crewmate practicing the sword. Her teacher's voice is reported within her own turn.
Julian Lopes is the speaker making the flattery in both town conversations. Lucia and Safia address him as Julian.
Shopkeeper is the shared role for the merchant who challenges the account of the Crusades. No personal name is given.
Trader is the standing role for the man Carlo addresses as Filippo. The conversation supplies the personal name.
Sailor is the underlying reusable actor role. The mock retreat belongs to the play scene Gerhard describes, and its existing actor and portrait are explicit source controls.
Boy is the source role for the child playing Charles Martel. The historical name belongs to the role he plays in speech.
Safia is the approved nameplate and the form Julian uses to greet her. The Medusa comparison remains figurative.
Lucia is the approved nameplate and the name Julian uses in the square. The empress comparison stays in speech.
